text:
Ava: Heads-up: partner onboarding call tomorrow 9am PT with CipherKey (HSM vendor) + MarketSquare marketplace team. Need runbook check.
Matt: Added agenda in the calendar invite. Main asks: SSO/SAML metadata exchange, SCIM provisioning attributes, KMS integration for secrets sync, and announcement timing.
Jordan: From infra side, KMS integration needs envelope flow + rotation policy. CipherKey requires CSR and cert pinning. Sophie, can CD team provide cert rotation window?
Sophie: We can do a 30-min downtime-free rotation with rolling cert update. Will need to schedule in dedicated deployment window for Private customers though.
Ava: Action items: (1) SSO metadata send (Matt), (2) SCIM attribute map + test users (Jordan), (3) KMS cert + key policy doc (Sophie), (4) marketplace listing copy (Ava). Ping partners-bot with artifact links.
partners-bot: Reminder: Please attach SAML metadata XML and SCIM schema docs to the invite. See checklist: https://redwood.internal/partner-checklist (private).
Matt: Draft SAML metadata attached. SCIM: sample payload below for group sync. Jordan please validate before call.
```json
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "userName": "test-ck-1", "externalId": "ck-123" }
```
Jordan: Quick note: CipherKey wants externalId to be email. I'll run a script to map local id -> email. Also will smoke-test SCIM provisioning via staging connector tonight.
Sophie: KMS notes: CipherKey supports HSM wrap/unwrap via PKCS#11 and an API for key import. We need to confirm supported algorithms (RSA-OAEP/ES). I'll paste minimal commands:
```bash
# import key
curl -X POST https://api.cipherkey.example/v1/keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -F 'key=@enc.key'
```
Ava: Marketing ask: embargo until joint announcement window. Proposed publish date 2024-12-05. Partners legal signoff needed by 2024-11-20.
Matt: :thumbsup: I'm on legal follow-up. Also confirm marketplace packaging for a 1-click deploy in AWS/GCP.
Jordan: Test plan: create 3 staged users, verify SSO login, SCIM create/update/delete, and KMS sign/unwrap. I'll post test matrix after staging run (ETA tonight).
Ava: Great. For the call tomorrow I'll open with a 5-min overview, hand over to infra for the technical deep-dive, then close with marketing/joint announcement timeline. Please add anything urgent now.
partners-bot: Deploy-bot scheduled a health-check at 02:00 UTC; that may affect staging connectors. @Jordan confirm if it collides.
deploy-bot: health-check scheduled at 02:00 UTC for staging infra. No expected downtime but connectors may restart.
Jordan: @deploy-bot noted — I'll re-run smoke tests after the health-check. If it collides, I'll shift to 05:00 UTC.
